features.name: Placement Readiness Dashboard
features.whatItDoes: Central analytics hub predicting campus placement probability (0-100%) using a calibrated Random Forest model trained on 972 historical student cohort records. Features HeroMetrics, continuous What-If Trajectory Simulator, and Live GitHub Fraud Shield.
features.whoItIsFor: Every engineering student wanting an immediate, data-backed assessment of their placement standing and projected CTC salary tier.
howToUse: Step 1: Inspect your Placement Readiness gauge and key metrics (CGPA, Coding score, Backlogs, Communication) on the Hero banner.
Step 2: Scroll to the What-If Sandbox to drag sliders and see how solving more LeetCode problems or shipping projects boosts your CTC in real time.

features.name: Readiness Command Hub & Priority Actions
features.whatItDoes: Tactical action engine that translates your skill gaps into immediate high-impact tasks, diagnostic audits, and focused preparation sprints.
features.whoItIsFor: Students looking for actionable daily directives instead of passive dashboards.
howToUse: Step 1: Review your prioritized Next Actions cards tailored to your target role.
Step 2: Click 'Launch Diagnostic' or 'Start Sprint' to immediately execute that preparation task.

features.name: 6-Week Placement Roadmap & Missions
features.whatItDoes: Constructs an adaptive semester-by-semester 6-week milestone roadmap targeting your dream role, detailing DSA patterns, CS core subjects, and project builds for each week.
features.whoItIsFor: Students preparing for campus drive seasons who need a clear week-by-week study syllabus.
howToUse: Step 1: Inspect the current week's mission deliverables and recommended study resources.
Step 2: Mark completed weekly milestones to advance your preparation progress and recalibrate odds.

features.name: 23 Production Project Blueprints & Tutor
features.whatItDoes: Library of 23 production-grade project blueprints across Backend, Full-Stack, AI/ML, Cloud, and Systems with step-by-step guidance and architectural walkthroughs.
features.whoItIsFor: Candidates needing high-caliber portfolio projects with resume impact bullet points.
howToUse: Step 1: Filter projects by domain (Backend, Full-Stack, AI/ML, Systems) and difficulty.
Step 2: Click 'Launch Blueprint' to inspect the system architecture diagram and step-by-step milestone tasks.

features.name: One-Page ATS Resume Studio
features.whatItDoes: Single-page ATS-optimized resume builder that compiles your profile, projects, and skills into a clean, PDF-ready resume formatted to pass enterprise ATS scanners.
features.whoItIsFor: Students needing a clean, professional tech resume without template clutter.
howToUse: Step 1: Review your auto-populated candidate information, work history, and quantified project bullets.
Step 2: Click 'Download PDF' or 'Print' to export your formatted single-page resume.

features.name: Project Defense & Technical Vetting
features.whatItDoes: Interactive interrogation console simulating a senior interviewer drilling into your project architectures, concurrency trade-offs, and failure points.
features.whoItIsFor: Students preparing for project round technical interviews at Tier-1 companies.
howToUse: Step 1: Select which project from your profile you wish to defend.
Step 2: Answer the AI interviewer's deep architectural questions aloud or in text to receive a STAR scorecard.

features.name: Career Digital Twin & Future Trajectory
features.whatItDoes: Simulates a 5-year digital twin model comparing your career trajectory against top alumni cohorts based on current skills and CGPA.
features.whoItIsFor: Students evaluating long-term ROI between specialized roles (e.g. SDE vs DevOps vs AI/ML).
howToUse: Step 1: Explore projected compensation bands and promotion velocities.
Step 2: Toggle skill acquisitions to observe compounding career dividends.

features.name: Cohort Placement Analytics & Benchmarks
features.whatItDoes: Real campus placement statistics from 972 engineering student cohort records filtered by branch, CTC, backlogs, and company tier.
features.whoItIsFor: Candidates wanting realistic salary benchmarks, highest package records (e.g. 44.6 LPA CSE/AIML), and branch-wise placement percentages.
howToUse: Step 1: Filter by branch (CSE, CSM, AIML, ECE, EEE, MECH) and minimum CGPA.
Step 2: Review CTC distribution histograms and company category matrices.

features.name: DAS AI Voice Agent & 3D Interactive Studio
features.whatItDoes: Voice-first 3D cybernetic placement strategist providing real-time technical answers, site navigation, project tutoring, and mock interviews with live lip-sync.
features.whoItIsFor: Students desiring a live, spoken pair-programming coach and mentor across all Pathfinder features.
howToUse: Step 1: Click the microphone or type in the input bar to speak with DAS.
Step 2: Listen to spoken guidance with matching 3D face lip-sync and inspect full answers in the slide-over sheet.

features.name: Candidate Profile & Skill Verifier
features.whatItDoes: Single source of truth for student academic background, LeetCode / GitHub verification, active backlogs, target role, and preferred company tiers.
features.whoItIsFor: All registered students keeping their readiness scores accurate and up to date.
howToUse: Step 1: Update your current CGPA, backlogs, or target role.
Step 2: Click 'Save & Recalculate' to update all placement probabilities across the platform.
